front_blocks.md: Define **microprocessor**.

back_blocks.md: A microprocessor is an **integrated circuit that contains a central processing unit**, and it is responsible for **executing instructions**.

cards.front_md: Define **microprocessor**.
cards.back_md: A microprocessor is an **integrated circuit that contains a central processing unit**, and it is responsible for **executing instructions**.

front_blocks.md: Give three devices in the home that microprocessors monitor and control.

back_blocks.md: Microprocessors in the home monitor and control **central heating systems**, **security alarm systems** and **home entertainment systems**.

cards.front_md: Give three devices in the home that microprocessors monitor and control.
cards.back_md: Microprocessors in the home monitor and control **central heating systems**, **security alarm systems** and **home entertainment systems**.

front_blocks.md: Name the three areas of life affected by microprocessor-controlled devices in the home.

back_blocks.md: They affect **lifestyle**, **leisure** and **physical fitness**.

cards.front_md: Name the three areas of life affected by microprocessor-controlled devices in the home.
cards.back_md: They affect **lifestyle**, **leisure** and **physical fitness**.

front_blocks.md: Give two positive effects of microprocessor-controlled devices on lifestyle.

back_blocks.md: They mean **fewer manual tasks**, devices can be **controlled from outside the home**, and **live security alerts** can be sent straight to a smartphone or computer.

cards.front_md: Give two positive effects of microprocessor-controlled devices on lifestyle.
cards.back_md: They mean **fewer manual tasks**, devices can be **controlled from outside the home**, and **live security alerts** can be sent straight to a smartphone or computer.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Microprocessor-controlled devices only have positive effects on physical fitness.

back_blocks.md: **False.**

They can cause a **loss of fitness** through fewer manual tasks, make people **lazy** through dependence on devices, create **unrealistic expectations** by comparing progress with others, and **biometric data is not always accurate**.

front_blocks.md: Give two negative effects of smart devices on social interaction.

back_blocks.md: They can lead to **social isolation**, **increased anxiety** from a lack of interaction, and differences in **the way people behave online compared to offline**.

cards.front_md: Give two negative effects of smart devices on social interaction.
cards.back_md: They can lead to **social isolation**, **increased anxiety** from a lack of interaction, and differences in **the way people behave online compared to offline**.

front_blocks.md: Why does any device fitted with a microprocessor create a security risk?

back_blocks.md: Any device fitted with a microprocessor is **open to cybercriminal activity**, giving hackers more opportunities, for example **hacking smart home cameras and locks**, or **monitoring smart heating patterns** to work out when people are at home.

cards.front_md: Why does any device fitted with a microprocessor create a security risk?

front_blocks.md: Give four transport systems that microprocessors monitor and control.

back_blocks.md: Microprocessors are used in **traffic management** such as smart motorways, **ANPR**, **air traffic control in airports** and **railway signalling**.

cards.front_md: Give four transport systems that microprocessors monitor and control.
cards.back_md: Microprocessors are used in **traffic management** such as smart motorways, **ANPR**, **air traffic control in airports** and **railway signalling**.

front_blocks.md: Give two advantages of monitoring and controlling transport with microprocessors.

back_blocks.md: There is **less human error**, reducing accidents; **efficient scheduling** means more trains or aeroplanes can run; **ANPR** can automatically penalise offences and check insurance; and **smart motorways** adapt in real time to reduce journey times.

cards.front_md: Give two advantages of monitoring and controlling transport with microprocessors.
cards.back_md: There is **less human error**, reducing accidents; **efficient scheduling** means more trains or aeroplanes can run; **ANPR** can automatically penalise offences and check insurance; and **smart motorways** adapt in real time to reduce journey times.

front_blocks.md: Give two disadvantages of monitoring and controlling transport with microprocessors.

back_blocks.md: If the **system fails the whole transport system stops**, it is **open to attack by cybercriminals**, **ANPR raises privacy concerns** by collecting data, and **design flaws can lead to safety concerns**.

cards.front_md: Give two disadvantages of monitoring and controlling transport with microprocessors.
cards.back_md: If the **system fails the whole transport system stops**, it is **open to attack by cybercriminals**, **ANPR raises privacy concerns** by collecting data, and **design flaws can lead to safety concerns**.

front_blocks.md: Autonomous vehicles use sensors, cameras, actuators and microprocessors to travel without <u>   </u> intervention.

back_blocks.md: Autonomous vehicles use sensors, cameras, actuators and microprocessors to travel without **human** intervention.

cards.front_md: Autonomous vehicles use sensors, cameras, actuators and microprocessors to travel without <u>   </u> intervention.
cards.back_md: Autonomous vehicles use sensors, cameras, actuators and microprocessors to travel without **human** intervention.

front_blocks.md: Give two advantages and two disadvantages of autonomous vehicles.

back_blocks.md: They are **better for the environment** through efficiency, **safer** with no human error, and **reduce traffic congestion**. However they are **expensive**, raise **security concerns** around software updates, need **higher maintenance**, could cause **unemployment**, and face **user reluctance**.

front_blocks.md: Name the four health issues caused by prolonged use of IT.

back_blocks.md: The four health issues are **repetitive strain injury (RSI)**, **back and neck problems**, **eye strain** and **headaches**.

cards.front_md: Name the four health issues caused by prolonged use of IT.
cards.back_md: The four health issues are **repetitive strain injury (RSI)**, **back and neck problems**, **eye strain** and **headaches**.

front_blocks.md: Define **repetitive strain injury**.

back_blocks.md: Repetitive strain injury is **damage to the fingers, wrists and joints**, traditionally caused by **prolonged use of a keyboard and mouse**.

cards.front_md: Define **repetitive strain injury**.
cards.back_md: Repetitive strain injury is **damage to the fingers, wrists and joints**, traditionally caused by **prolonged use of a keyboard and mouse**.

front_blocks.md: Give three effects of repetitive strain injury.

back_blocks.md: The effects of RSI are **pain**, **numbness**, **weakness** and **stiffness**.

cards.front_md: Give three effects of repetitive strain injury.
cards.back_md: The effects of RSI are **pain**, **numbness**, **weakness** and **stiffness**.

front_blocks.md: Give three ways to reduce the risk of repetitive strain injury.

back_blocks.md: Have the **correct posture**, use a **wrist support** if necessary, **take regular breaks**, and use an **ergonomic keyboard**.

cards.front_md: Give three ways to reduce the risk of repetitive strain injury.
cards.back_md: Have the **correct posture**, use a **wrist support** if necessary, **take regular breaks**, and use an **ergonomic keyboard**.

front_blocks.md: What causes back and neck problems when using IT?

back_blocks.md: Back and neck problems are caused by **sitting in front of a computer screen for prolonged periods of time**.

cards.front_md: What causes back and neck problems when using IT?
cards.back_md: Back and neck problems are caused by **sitting in front of a computer screen for prolonged periods of time**.

front_blocks.md: Give three ways to reduce the risk of back and neck problems.

back_blocks.md: Use an **adjustable chair**, take **regular breaks**, and use a **foot rest**.

cards.front_md: Give three ways to reduce the risk of back and neck problems.
cards.back_md: Use an **adjustable chair**, take **regular breaks**, and use a **foot rest**.

front_blocks.md: What causes eye strain?

back_blocks.md: Eye strain is caused by **staring at a computer screen for prolonged periods of time**, or by **incorrect lighting causing reflections**.

cards.front_md: What causes eye strain?
cards.back_md: Eye strain is caused by **staring at a computer screen for prolonged periods of time**, or by **incorrect lighting causing reflections**.

front_blocks.md: Give three effects of eye strain.

back_blocks.md: The effects of eye strain are **headaches**, **vision problems** such as blurred or double vision and light sensitivity, and general **discomfort**.

cards.front_md: Give three effects of eye strain.
cards.back_md: The effects of eye strain are **headaches**, **vision problems** such as blurred or double vision and light sensitivity, and general **discomfort**.

front_blocks.md: Give three ways to reduce the risk of eye strain.

back_blocks.md: **Take regular breaks**, use an **anti-glare screen filter**, and **change from a CRT to an LCD monitor**.

cards.front_md: Give three ways to reduce the risk of eye strain.
cards.back_md: **Take regular breaks**, use an **anti-glare screen filter**, and **change from a CRT to an LCD monitor**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Headaches when using IT are caused by a single factor.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Headaches are caused by a **combination of factors**, including **poor lighting**, **flickering screens**, **reflections** and **fatigue**.

back_blocks.md: **Taking regular breaks** is recommended for RSI, back and neck problems, eye strain and headaches.
